review_type: one bounded documentary and static-code pass
input_snapshot: Final staged working copies supplied by root; review applies only to SHA256 hashes below.
scope: Qualification amendment interpretations, including all six final entries.
BLU safety and model Markdown/JSON consistency with the preserved Round8 qualification rules.
Static inspection of the unchanged decision utility to assess algorithmic-enforcement claims.

checks.finding: Near-complete persistent genetic C2alpha inactivation is explicitly distinguished from reversible drug exposure. The 2.7% activity observation is not converted into BLU occupancy, safe inhibition, duration or a human dose.
checks.boundary: The retained 20% antitarget objective remains a prospective interpretation target, not a demonstrated safety threshold; no numerical rule changed.

checks.finding: The tumor deletion and kinase-defective add-back findings remain tissue- and perturbation-specific. Neither BLU cancer harm nor protection is inferred. Stable total protein is not claimed to establish preserved scaffolding.
checks.boundary: The endothelial catalytic-inactivation observation is retained separately; the tumor result does not dismiss it.

checks.finding: The amendments expressly preserve recognition and independent confirmation of a credible first force signal without a completed delayed-rescue-control program, fully qualified comparator, or new systemic safety battery.
checks.boundary: Exposure, precision, model qualification and functional-liability interpretation remain required within their original scope. Delayed modifiability and orthogonal support constrain strong negative/target conclusions, not recognition of a credible positive.

checks.finding: The amendment file labels all added conditions as manual scientific interpretation and explicitly states that the preserved utility does not automatically enforce them. Static code inspection is consistent: the utility accepts documented flags and numerical summaries and does not ingest or evaluate these six new contextual conditions.
checks.boundary: A software advance is neither scientific certification nor proof that manual conditions were met; no new code enforcement, execution test or biological result is claimed by this review.

checks.finding: The 2024 abstract has no BLU test or audited force-response denominator. Nonsignificant calcium differences do not establish equivalence; unmatched 2024 and 2026 reports are not treated as one longitudinal model lineage.
checks.boundary: Missing exact-line residual function, maturity, variance, control identity and delayed force rescue remain explicit unknowns.

checks.finding: All reviewed JSON files parse; the safety JSON companion hash matches the staged Markdown. The three reviewed baseline files are byte-identical to the recovered Round8 copies. The final amendment snapshot contains six entries.
checks.boundary: This is a file-content review, not verification of a future git commit, branch, complete manifest or any files edited after these hashes.

scope_limits: No new web search or independent re-extraction of primary figures was performed; this pass challenges translation and decision logic, not every upstream source fact.
No code was executed to generate synthetic decisions or planning outputs; algorithmic claims were assessed by static inspection.
No experimental authorization, procurement, outreach, clinical safety clearance, target validation or efficacy certification follows from this pass.
Any change to the hashed inputs requires review proportional to that change; this pass does not certify later versions.
recommendation: Integrate the six manual interpretation amendments with the preserved Round8 specification. Keep the first-proof recommendation and distinguish manual scientific review from numerical utility output.
